scope.operator: single-token layer-0 MLP gate and up projections
scope.claim_boundary: exact-shape synthetic microkernel evidence only; no model quality, whole-graph, token-throughput, energy, or breakthrough claim

candidate.isa: x86_64 AVX2 plus FMA when enabled by the native build
candidate.design: reuse each shared CQ8_0 activation vector across four gate and four up rows while preserving the per-row arithmetic and reduction order
candidate.fallback: the existing generic CQ3_0 dot product for non-AVX2 x86 builds
candidate.integration_status: microkernel prerequisite only; not wired into the ggml graph executor

control.implementation: two complete projections through the existing dispatched ggml_vec_dot_cq3_0_cq8_0 path
control.execution_order: all gate rows followed by all up rows

benchmark.paired_order: alternate control-first and candidate-first inside one process
benchmark.benchmark_weights: deterministic synthetic ternary rows at the exact Qwen3.8-27B projection shape; not real model artifact bytes
benchmark.activation: deterministic FP32 vector quantized once to CQ8_0
benchmark.primary_metric: ratio of control median microseconds to candidate median microseconds

promotion.negative_result_rule: a valid speedup below 1.03 is recorded as a kernel rejection, not an infrastructure failure
promotion.next_gate_if_promoted: wire the paired kernel into a guarded x86 ggml graph path, then require backend reference tests and Qwen3.8-27B CUTE plus MMLU parity before end-to-end token-throughput comparison
